body: Owner request (Aman Bansal, 2026-10-07): build a universal Go package, usable as a library, for schedules, cron jobs and background work, with ubgo/sqlb as the data layer and ubgo/auth as the structural template. Hatchet is the main engine but sits behind the library as an adapter, so the same cron and scheduling code works anywhere: in-process, SQLite, Postgres, and distributed when needed. First step: a full mission, a feature study and a brainstorm before any code. References: template ubgo/auth; data layer ubgo/sqlb. Backends: in-process, SQLite, Postgres (sqlb), Hatchet as an adapter; single-node or distributed.
title: ubgo/workflow: the one scheduler, cron and durable-job library every Go app needs
